own_member_inclusion: Use public_plus_own only when mean paired fold AUC delta > 2*SE and at least 4/5 folds positive; otherwise choose public_only.
final_fit: Same C=0.003 on all available training rows, only after converged paired five-fold evaluation. No hyperparameter or weight search.
fallback: Do not generate a candidate if resource deadline or convergence fails. Preserve all checkpoints.
source_drift: Missing or changed members explicitly reported; never silently claim identical 247-member reconstruction.
validation: Historical fixed-base-OOF evaluation, not end-to-end strict CV.
